items.title: Treasury agent
items.promise: Rank which bills to pay when cash isn't enough for all of them.
items.body: Fund, convert, defer, or escalate. After a later deposit, only reopen decisions the new cash actually changes.
items.brief:
You're building a treasury agent. Airwallex sandbox only (https://mcp.sandbox.airwallex.com/developer).

Cash isn't enough for every near-term obligation. Rank what to fund, convert, defer, or escalate. Keep amounts, reserves, and approvals in code. After a simulated deposit, only reopen decisions the new cash actually changes.

On every create, send a request_id. Reuse it when you retry. Generate a new one when you mean a new payment.
watch: Add the SWIFT fee (EUR 12.85 in these examples) into the conversion. LOCAL payouts have no fee.
Leave x-api-version off FX calls.
Treat a quote as single-use in your code. Airwallex will accept the same quote_id again with a new request_id.
Book the conversion over REST. No MCP tool for it.

items.title: Purchase agent
items.promise: Compare two quotes against cash, then issue a card with matching spending limits.
items.body: Calculate the cash effect in code. Set the card limit so over-limit authorizations decline.
items.brief:
You're building a purchase agent. Airwallex sandbox only (https://mcp.sandbox.airwallex.com/developer).

Compare two quotes against cash and policy. Issue a virtual card with spending limits that match that decision. Simulate one authorization that should decline and one that should clear.

On every create, send a request_id. Reuse it when you retry. Generate a new one when you mean a new payment.
watch: Don't wait for APPROVED. CLEARING means accepted. failure_reason means declined.
Per-transaction limits are inclusive. Equal to the limit clears.
Card declines end FAILED. Failed transfers end CANCELLED. Separate state machines.
Cardholder field is cardholder_type on MCP and type on REST.

items.title: Payment recovery agent
items.promise: When a supplier says a payout didn't arrive, wait, replace, or escalate — without paying twice.
items.body: Leave the failed transfer cancelled. Send the replacement as a new transfer with a new request_id.
items.brief:
You're building a payment recovery agent. Airwallex sandbox only (https://mcp.sandbox.airwallex.com/developer).

A supplier says a transfer didn't arrive. Wait while it's in flight. After a terminal failure, send one replacement. Don't pay the same obligation twice.

On every create, send a request_id. Reuse it when you retry. Generate a new one when you mean a new payment.
watch: SENT before PAID. FAILED with a failure_type also needs SENT first.
Prefer FAILED plus failure_type over a bare cancel. Bare cancel only gives failure_reason simulation.
Original and replacement need different request_id values.
Two SWIFT payouts means two fees. Don't close the incident only because the replacement is PAID.

items.title: Chargeback agent
items.promise: Accept, challenge, or escalate a dispute based on value and fees.
items.body: If the issuer rejects the evidence, don't send the same file again.
items.brief:
You're building a chargeback agent. Airwallex sandbox only (https://mcp.sandbox.airwallex.com/developer).

Three chargebacks, different economics: accept, challenge, or hand to a person. If the issuer rejects the evidence, challenge again only with new evidence, or accept.

On every create, send a request_id. Reuse it when you retry. Generate a new one when you mean a new payment.
steps: Simulate escalate, then challenge again with new evidence or accept
watch: Challenge and accept over REST.
Sandbox does not deduct the dispute fee. Put it in your own economics.
Create disputes at RFI or CHARGEBACK. PRE_CHARGEBACK auto-accepts in the same second.
Evidence is JPG or PDF. PNG is rejected. Test card 4035501000000008.

items.title: Corporate card platform
items.promise: Issue spend cards to customers, fund each wallet, and set limits per card.
items.body: You can't fund every customer. Fund one, defer another, and show why a charge declined.
items.brief:
You're building a corporate card platform. Airwallex sandbox only (https://mcp.sandbox.airwallex.com/developer).

Needs a connected account per customer. Create, submit, and activate before anything else. Connected accounts and platform payments are not self-serve. Email devhelp@airwallex.com with your sandbox email and Client ID if they aren't already on.

Each customer has their own wallet. Issue a card per customer. You can't fund everyone: fund one wallet, defer another, and show declines for funds, limit, and currency.

On every create, send a request_id. Reuse it when you retry. Generate a new one when you mean a new payment.
steps: Create and activate a connected account per customer
Run the allocator, fund one, defer another
watch: Fund the customer wallet enough to hit the card-limit check, or you only see insufficient funds.
Send x-on-behalf-of on the card simulation. Without it Airwallex reports failure and still creates the transaction.
Customer cards over REST. MCP cannot send x-on-behalf-of.

items.title: Contractor payroll platform
items.promise: Run payroll for many companies and pay contractors in local currencies.
items.body: Include transfer fees before you convert. A deposit in one company's wallet must not pay another company.
items.brief:
You're building a contractor payroll platform. Airwallex sandbox only (https://mcp.sandbox.airwallex.com/developer).

Needs a connected account per customer. Create, submit, and activate before anything else. Connected accounts and platform payments are not self-serve. Email devhelp@airwallex.com with your sandbox email and Client ID if they aren't already on.

Each company has its own wallet. Price each payroll including transfer fees before converting. Pay contractors from that company's wallet only. A deposit into one wallet must not fund another company.

On every create, send a request_id. Reuse it when you retry. Generate a new one when you mean a new payment.
steps: Create and activate a connected account per employer. Fund two.
POST /api/v1/beneficiaries/validate then create with the header
FX quote and conversion with the header if needed
watch: Price SWIFT fees before converting or the last contractor won't fit.
Set transfer_method on each contractor. Don't infer it from a missing fee.
x-on-behalf-of on every employer FX call. Without it Airwallex converts the platform wallet and still returns 201.
Customer transfers stay PROCESSING until you simulate them to a terminal status.

items.title: Revenue-based lending platform
items.promise: Advance cash to borrowers and collect a contracted share of revenue.
items.body: Collect from actual revenue, not the forecast. Size the next advance so the reserve floor still holds.
items.brief:
You're building a revenue-based lending platform. Airwallex sandbox only (https://mcp.sandbox.airwallex.com/developer).

Needs a connected account per customer. Create, submit, and activate before anything else. Connected accounts and platform payments are not self-serve. Email devhelp@airwallex.com with your sandbox email and Client ID if they aren't already on.

Each borrower has their own wallet. Collect the contracted share of actual revenue, apply a reserve floor, and size a new advance underneath that ceiling.

On every create, send a request_id. Reuse it when you retry. Generate a new one when you mean a new payment.
steps: Create and activate a connected account per borrower
watch: Set the reserve floor high enough that the next advance is constrained.
Read the borrower balance before collecting. If it can't cover, carry a receivable instead of a failed charge.
platform_reports: type BALANCE_REPORT, no date filters. Download within 60 seconds of the link.

items.title: Marketplace payments platform
items.promise: Collect buyer money, settle sellers, hold a reserve for refunds.
items.body: If risk changes for one seller, don't recalculate the others.
items.brief:
You're building a marketplace payments platform. Airwallex sandbox only (https://mcp.sandbox.airwallex.com/developer).

Needs a connected account per customer. Create, submit, and activate before anything else. Connected accounts and platform payments are not self-serve. Email devhelp@airwallex.com with your sandbox email and Client ID if they aren't already on.

Each seller has their own wallet. Pay sellers their net, hold a reserve against refunds, and when new risk hits one seller, leave the other reserves alone.

On every create, send a request_id. Reuse it when you retry. Generate a new one when you mean a new payment.
steps: Create and activate a connected account per seller
POST /api/v1/simulation/deposit/create — stage the platform pool (no header)
POST /api/v1/connected_account_transfers/create — pay each seller its net
Recalculate one seller's reserve. Leave the others alone.
POST /api/v1/charges/create to recover a shortfall, or transfer to release reserve
watch: Track reserves in your own ledger. Airwallex has no escrow object for this flow.
Reconcile each cycle: payouts, refunds, and unreleased reserve.
Check the seller wallet before recovering a shortfall.
Recalculate only the seller the new evidence hits.
